newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - July 7.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - July 7.

text.p: (DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Bunker prices were up marginally from Friday's quotes, but slipped from its midday high on Monday, traders said. Most deals were concluded at $98.50 per tonne for 380-cst supplies, down from $100 quoted earlier. Traders said the bunker market did not rise as much as expected earlier, prices in the cargo market remained stable.
